title: The Lantern
how_1: Under the lantern is a name from the museum: a place or a person.
how_2: Pick a letter. If it is in the name it appears; if not, the lantern loses a drop of oil.
how_3: Reveal the name before the seven drops run out.
lost: The lantern went out. The name was {name}.
